explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/437: Erdős–Graham's 'trivial' (in fact Siegel-dependent) claim that the number of squares is o(x). L x is the maximum number of square partial products a₁⋯a_i of a strictly increasing list in [1,x], as on erdosproblems.com/437; the set is bounded by x, so the sSup is a maximum. The statement is L x = o(x). Faithful.
